Hello Juan,

Please find the email below from Winn-Dixie related to this RCS.

Because of an internal issue on 06/25 all the data for some locations was not sent to Appriss through the API. We did a reprocess of the data and created a file for the API process to pickup and send. The file contained all the TLOG data for 06/25/2026 since we could not determine what had been sent.

  • The data for store 358 was processed through the API. 

  • The internal file name was TL358_20260625999999999.tlg which would not have been sent through the API.  

  • This was sent to Appriss production.

  • We are not seeing the additional data in production when we run a query using the data in “Secure Store"

We can rebuild the file again and have someone monitor on the Appriss side to determine if there is an issue with processing the data since it would be a resend of a portion of the data for a location.

Matthew

Planned PTO:  None

","created":"2026-07-22T12:00:14.691-0400","updated":"2026-07-22T12:00:14.691-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"61f44bbaaeaacb0072265cd4","displayName":"Shireesh Ramdas"},"jsdPublic":false},{"id":"3254392","author":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"body":"

Hi Heaven, thank you for the details from your IT team. I verified store 358 directly in our production data and can confirm the discrepancy. For 06/25/2026, we only received 773 transactions for store 358, compared to a normal daily volume of approximately 2,300–2,600 transactions on the surrounding days (06/24 = 2,323 and 06/26 = 2,421). This indicates that a significant portion of that day's data did not make it into our production environment, which aligns with the internal issue Matthew described.

To clarify our earlier response, our initial investigation focused on the SFTP archive. However, since this data was originally transmitted through the Ingestion API rather than as an SFTP file, that was not the correct location to verify receipt, which is why it was initially reported as not received.

As discussed, please go ahead and rebuild and resend the 06/25/2026 data for store 358 through the Ingestion API, as Matthew suggested. When you do, please let us know the date and time the resend is triggered so we can monitor the ingestion in real time on our side and confirm it is processed successfully.

Once the data has been ingested, we'll verify the transaction counts for 06/25/2026 and confirm that they are consistent with a normal day's volume.

Thank you!

Hi @Heaven Poirot ,

Thank you for following up on this, and please pass my thanks to Matthew for setting up the resend and keeping me posted on the timing.

I went back and checked our production data for store 358 on 06/25/2026. The counts are unchanged from what I shared in July, so the transactions that were missing for that day have not reached us yet.

I do see the resend itself. A larger than usual batch came through on 09/10 and it processed normally on our side. Looking at the transaction dates inside that batch, the earliest one is 07/02/2026, so it looks like 06/25 was not part of what was rebuilt.

I may be reading this differently than your team, so I wanted to share what I am seeing rather than assume anything.

Whenever you and Matthew have a moment, could you have the data rebuilt so that it covers 06/25/2026 for store 358? If you let me know when it goes out, I will watch for it and post the counts here once it lands.

I appreciate all the work that has gone into this on your side. Please reach out any time if something looks different from where you sit.

Kind regards,

Juan Martinez
Appriss Retail Support
